subject: Startups
title: How Startups Hit $1 Billion
description: A quick, practical guide to How Startups Hit $1 Billion.

hook.text: The median time from founding to unicorn status is about 7 years. Some do it in 2. Others take 15.

buildup.text: The typical path: seed round, then Series A through D, each at 2-3x the previous valuation as milestones are hit.

discovery.text: Companies cross $1B by showing explosive revenue growth, dominant market share, or a massive addressable market.

twist.text: Some unicorns reach $1B on hype alone with little revenue. This works until public markets demand real financials.

climax.text: The fastest unicorn ever was Jet.com: 4 months from launch to $1B valuation. Walmart bought it for $3.3B a year later.

punchline.text: Speed to unicorn varies. Speed to profitability matters more.

quiz.question: What is the median time from founding to unicorn status?
